Earlier studies have investigated the effects of composition, heat treatment, and processing conditions on the microstructure and properties of HEAs. The trend suggests a growing interest in understanding the intrinsic factors governing the phase stability and mechanical behavior of HEAs, including the role of impurities, grain size, and dislocation behavior.
